name: Gemini Notebook API
description: Creates and manages Gemini notebooks and ingests web pages, YouTube videos, text, and Markdown as sources, via a REST API and remote MCP server. Public Preview.

skills.name: Manage Notebooks
skills.description: Creates, gets, lists, and renames Gemini notebooks, filtering the list by whether the caller owns each notebook.

skills.name: Add Sources
skills.description: Ingests a public web page, a captioned YouTube video, or plain text or Markdown up to 500,000 words into a notebook.

skills.name: Track Sources
skills.description: Lists a notebook's sources and gets each source's metadata and processing state: processing, active, or failed.

skills.name: Notebook MCP Server
skills.description: Connects coding agents and IDEs to seven notebook and source tools over a remote Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint.
